title: 철도물류산업의 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행령 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
title_original: 철도물류산업의 육성 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
Article 4 (Standards for Bearing Costs of Relocating Railroad Logistics Facilities)
(1) Pursuant to Article 10 (2) of the Act, relocation costs of railroad logistics facilities that may be borne by a project implementer under the Act on the Construction of Railroads and Maintenance of Railroad Facilities or by a person requesting railroad construction shall be as follows: <Amended on March 12, 2019>
1. Costs of relocating railroad facilities under Article 2, subparagraph 2 (a) of the Act, limited to railroad facilities of dedicated railways under Article 2, subparagraph 5 of the Railroad Business Act;
2. Costs of relocating logistics facilities under Article 2 (1) 4 (a) and (b) of the Framework Act on Logistics Policies.
(2) The costs borne under paragraph (1) shall not exceed the amount obtained by subtracting the appraised value of the existing railroad logistics facilities from the total costs incurred by a railroad logistics business operator, excluding the Korea Railroad Corporation, in relocating the facilities pursuant to Article 10 (2) of the Act. The appraised value means the arithmetic mean of values assessed by at least two appraisal corporations, etc. under the Act on Appraisal and Appraisers before relocation. <Amended on January 21, 2022>
